checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same man, short grey hair, recognisable features
must.why: Face, hair, stubble and expression are closely preserved, though slightly refined and sharper.
Navy blazer with white open-collar shirt.

must.item: Harsh lighting softened, realistic skin texture kept
must.why: Even soft lighting, with skin texture and wrinkles retained; slight highlight on the forehead.
Clean composition, no obvious artifacts; slightly polished AI look.

faults.what: Facial details are slightly altered and the image looks a little over-polished, with a brighter forehead highlight. Identity is still close.
The reply says 'no tie' as an option, but the image has no tie anyway, which is harmless. The shirt collar is open and slightly asymmetric.

summary: The output is a clean, professional headshot of the same man in a navy blazer and white shirt on a grey backdrop, with only slight AI polish as a flaw.
